supporting_observations.interpretation: Checkpoint100 original427 frozenBF16 base tensors match pretrained; actual496 LoRA tensors/rank are FP32 Shard(0). These exclude some storage/base-state explanations and do not establish update/gradient correctness or vLLM every-upload equality. First sustained degradation35–40 precedes later NaN skip updates83/85/109.

findings.finding: Worker calls the original actor.update_policy; original actor switches to train and calls its existing optimizer step after original microbatch backward/accumulation. No new updater is inserted. Nonfinite grad norms are skipped by the original optimizer path.
findings.limit: Source contract is not a replay of missing historical full-batch gradients or proof of correct token credit.

findings.finding: Every native sharder entry collects a fresh PEFT state mapping, materializes DTensors by full_tensor().detach().cpu(), applies original Qwen ABI key mapping and uploads a TensorLoRARequest to add_lora. With recorded safetensors load_format, base_sync_done starts true and the LoRA branch returns before base load_weights. Official tool collector is wrapped by begin/end context with finally; within that collection there is one policy sync and no actor update between turns.
findings.limit: Current actor values are read by source; every historical upload and selected engine adapter ID/value were not saved.

findings.finding: The recorded world-size-2 Shard(0) export path isolates actor storage at native full_tensor all-gather. PEFT shallow references and no-op detach/cpu do not bypass that gather. No actor B storage alias defect is supported by this source path.
additional_findings: vLLM may fold alpha/r into its gathered export payload if from_lora_tensors retains that storage. Such payload-local mutation is expected owner behavior and is distinct from actor mutation.

Fresh native collection/ID per sync, optimize->scaling=1, packed scaling=1, and cache activation without optimize do not implement a repeated alpha/r scaling loop. No repeated-scaling defect is supported for this recorded native path.
findings.limit: Prior ownership audit applies to actual world-size-two Shard(0) layout. It does not establish actor-vLLM numerical equality on every rollout.

findings.finding: Actual worker configures max_loras=1; rollout selects the first ID returned by list_loras and sends the original LoRARequest. The transport hijack replaces _load_adapter and does not explicitly clear all cached adapters.
findings.not_observed: No saved old-job multiple-ID list, stale selected ID, adapter-value mismatch or per-sync failure establishes a stale-adapter defect. max_loras=1 alone is not a record of resolved max_cpu_loras/cache capacity or eviction behavior. Resolved installed vLLM lora_dtype is not recorded here.
findings.production_action: No adapter-cache patch or configuration change is justified.

findings.finding: For rank>0 LoRA, compute_ref_log_prob sets is_lora=True and calls the same native actor log-prob path inside actor_module.disable_adapter(). It returns ref_log_prob from that no-LoRA result. Native actor compute_log_prob enters eval and no_grad.
findings.limit: Callsite uses the upstream PEFT context manager. This audit does not replace or dynamically revalidate its installed internals or historical context state.

findings.finding: DT snapshots actor.training and attention implementation, enters eval/FA plus scoped native FLA precision, and finally restores attention and prior actor training mode. Native FLA scope finally restores original chunk function. DT worker offload is in finally; sharder exit calls module.train(); update_policy explicitly calls train().
findings.limit: These exception-safe callsites do not show a historical mode/backend leak. compute_log_prob optional explicit offload is not in finally, but actual FSDP2 CPUOffloadPolicy path sets _is_offload_param=False; no corresponding old-job exception leak is evidenced.

findings.finding: Worker lazily creates and retains one DeltaTraceRolloutProducer. It aliases the current actor/FSDP root, existing language layers and actual lm_head rather than copying a checkpoint. The producer/runner/compiled function objects persist; tensor weight values are not frozen by constructor. EventRatioReadout keeps runner, alphabet and last_report; episode request/vector lists are constructed per call.
findings.limit: Persistent module identity does not by itself prove either stale values or runtime freshness.

findings.finding: Each finite projection invokes _linear_weights(module), reads current module.weight, checks active/merged/disabled adapter state and calls existing get_delta_weight(active_adapter). Attention q/k/v/o, MLP gate/up/down, GDN in/out projections, normalization weight and categorical head rows are read during the current attribution/replay; head.weight is selected at each answer call. They are not kept in a cross-update value dictionary.
findings.limit: No source-level cache keyed by weight tensor identity is present in these audited readers. FSDP unshard/replay callbacks use current actor modules; not a historical update-after-read equality observation.

findings.finding: FiniteBoundaryOps and FiniteAnswerOps compile functions, with projection/head/norm weights passed as call operands. The compiled norm wrapper also passes weight explicitly. This path does not close over an initial actor weight snapshot.
findings.limit: Not a general assertion about all Torch compiler implementations or every historical generated graph; no actual frozen-operand evidence was found.

findings.finding: Actual old c9 attribute initializes replay_cache and native_cache as local None each call. If prefix reuse is enabled, the same current actor native forward computes that call’s prefix; its fork is used only within that attribution. Actual old readout has no prefix_lease_factory/native_prefix_leases/external bank. New AppWorld cross-group banks and the newer workspace runner are outside this job’s import path.
findings.limit: No cross-attribution prefix-value cache is implemented in the recorded old TextCraft source.

findings.finding: The data_ptr/dtype/shape/stride key deduplicates Q/K/V interface views inside a newly created NativeDenseAttentionCapture. The dictionary is reset for the current native attention call, and runner creates new capture objects for each layer/attribute. It is not a model-weight cache across AdamW updates.

Current-owner view registers the actor’s original FSDP forward, uses original unshard/reshard APIs before and after finite layer replay, and exposes release_owner_params to reshard retained owner handles and clear the list. Pinned credit bridge calls release_owner_params in finally around runner.attribute.
findings.limit: The release bridge blob agrees at c9/submission/producer-matching commits, but this bridge’s actual old imported SHA is not separately recorded; it is marked pinned-only rather than a witnessed live import.

source_level_exclusions: No actor-shard alias or repeated alpha/r scaling loop is supported by actual native LoRA export path.
No frozen initial LoRA/projection/head value cache was found in actual old persistent DT source.
No old TextCraft cross-attribution prefix bank or cross-update weight data_ptr cache is implemented in the audited path.
Reference uses native LoRA-disabled actor call; DT restores prior training/backend bindings.
not_proven: Correctness of all historical uploads, chosen vLLM IDs, weights or mode transitions.
Correctness of DT per-token credit from conservation, selected extrema, base equality or nonzero gradients.
A causal explanation of smooth entropy growth/success collapse.
conclusion.existing_defect_scope: The independently demonstrated truncated-terminal-reward wiring defect remains separate; this audit does not claim that it explains all degradation.

smallest_optional_actual_observation.status: proposed only; no new launch/update/GPU call by this audit; not an independent-evaluation prerequisite
smallest_optional_actual_observation.occasion: If root elects to observe an already-authorized real native optimizer update, reuse one actual B4 and the same updated actor after that native update.
smallest_optional_actual_observation.comparison: Existing persistent producer readout versus a fresh original owner/readout reading the same updated actor parameters, with exact original IDs/targets/options/source spans. Record current native projection/LoRA operands and factual/ref/root/signed output. Preserve original binding/backend/mode lifetimes; no cloned model or replacement computation.
smallest_optional_actual_observation.interpretation: This distinguishes a persistent-owner freshness effect on that actual update/input from both owners reading the same current weights. It is not a reconstruction of the missing bad historical updates, a token-credit accuracy proof, or a new numerical pass criterion.
